title_en: Amendment to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
1. One article is added after Article 162, as Article 162 A: "Whoever conceals or intentionally destroys accounting vouchers, accounting books, or financial accounting reports that shall be preserved according to law shall, if the circumstances are serious, be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall also, or shall only, be fined not less than 20,000 yuan but not more than 200,000 yuan.
"Where a unit commits the crime mentioned in the preceding paragraph, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons who are directly in charge and the other persons who are directly responsible for the crime shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph."

2. Article 168 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Where a staff member of a State-owned company or enterprise, through severe irresponsibility or abuse of power, causes bankruptcy or serious losses to the State-owned company or enterprise, thereby causing major losses to the interests of the State, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; if he causes especially major losses to the interests of the State, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years.
"Where a staff member of a State-owned institution commits the act mentioned in the preceding paragraph, thereby causing major losses to the interests of the State, he shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
"Where a staff member of a State-owned company, enterprise, or institution engages in malpractice for personal gain and commits the crime mentioned in the preceding two paragraphs, he shall be given a severe punishment in accordance with the provisions of the first paragraph."

3. Article 174 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever, without the approval of the competent department of the State, establishes a commercial bank, stock exchange, futures exchange, securities company, futures brokerage company, insurance company, or any other financial institution shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also, or shall only, be fined not less than 20,000 yuan but not more than 200,000 yuan; if the circumstances are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 500,000 yuan.
"Whoever forges, alters, or transfers the business license or approval document of a commercial bank, stock exchange, futures exchange, securities company, futures brokerage company, insurance company, or any other financial institution shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
"Where a unit commits the crime mentioned in the preceding two paragraphs, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons who are directly in charge and the other persons who are directly responsible for the crime shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the first paragraph."

4. Article 180 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Any person who has knowledge of inside information on securities or futures transactions or who illegally obtains such inside information, and, before the information concerning the issuance of securities, the securities or futures transactions, or other information that has a major impact on the prices of securities or futures transactions is made public, buys or sells the securities, engages in futures transactions related to such inside information, or divulges such information, shall, if the circumstances are serious, be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall also, or shall only, be fined not less than one time but not more than five times the illegal gains; if the circumstances are especially serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined not less than one time but not more than five times the illegal gains.
"Where a unit commits the crime mentioned in the preceding paragraph, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons who are directly in charge and the other persons who are directly responsible for the crime shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention.
"The scope of inside information and persons with knowledge thereof shall be determined in accordance with the provisions of laws and administrative regulations."

5. Article 181 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever fabricates and disseminates false information that affects securities or futures transactions, thereby disrupting the securities or futures trading market and causing serious consequences, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall also, or shall only, be fined not less than 10,000 yuan but not more than 100,000 yuan.
"Any employee of a stock exchange, futures exchange, securities company, or futures brokerage company, or any staff member of the securities industry association, futures industry association, or securities and futures regulatory authority, who knowingly provides false information, or forges, alters, or destroys trading records, in order to induce investors to buy or sell securities or futures contracts, thereby causing serious consequences, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall also, or shall only, be fined not less than 10,000 yuan but not more than 100,000 yuan; if the circumstances are especially flagrant, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined not less than 20,000 yuan but not more than 200,000 yuan.
"Where a unit commits the crime mentioned in the preceding two paragraphs, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons who are directly in charge and the other persons who are directly responsible for the crime shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention."

7. Article 185 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Any staff member of a commercial bank, stock exchange, futures exchange, securities company, futures brokerage company, insurance company, or any other financial institution who, taking advantage of his position, misappropriates funds of the unit or of a client shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 272 of this Law.
"Any staff member of a State-owned commercial bank, stock exchange, futures exchange, securities company, futures brokerage company, insurance company, or any other State-owned financial institution, or any person who is assigned by a State-owned commercial bank, stock exchange, futures exchange, securities company, futures brokerage company, insurance company, or any other State-owned financial institution to a non-State-owned institution mentioned in the preceding paragraph to engage in public service, who commits the act mentioned in the preceding paragraph shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 384 of this Law."

8. One item is added to Article 225 of the Criminal Law as item (3): "engaging in illegal securities, futures, or insurance business without the approval of the competent department of the State;" the original item (3) is changed to item (4).
9. This Amendment shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
